field_changes.old: JEFIT now feels right at home on iOS 26 — enjoy the sleek Liquid Glass design across navigation, sheets, and menus throughout the app. Planning your program just got smoother too: Copy Day and Add a Day are now single streamlined sheets that drop you right where you need to be. Training prescriptions are also more accurate for metric users, and we've squashed a handful of bugs along the way.
field_changes.new: Edit your available weights right from the workout screen — tap ⋯ on any exercise to update your plates or dumbbells and watch planned sets adjust automatically. Adaptive Plans now properly pause weight progressions during deload weeks. Returning users get a "Continue as" shortcut at login, and weight entry now accepts your local decimal separator. Plus a handful of bug fixes.
